app-title: Ikigo cy'Uburezi cy'Abapayiniya ba Afurika - Hanze
welcome-sub: Irembo ryo Gushimangira Afurika binyuze muri Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Mu kwizihiza Umunsi wa Afurika wa 25, iyi Porogaramu yo Kwamaza Pi Pioneers iratangijwe)
intro-p1: Pi Network ni ifaranga rya digitale n'umushinga w'ibidukikije ku rwego rw'isi wagenewe gutuma cryptocurrency igerwaho kandi igirire akamaro kuri buri wese.
intro-p2: Bitandukanye n'andi ma-cryptocurrencies gakondo asaba imashini zicukura zihenze, Pi Network yemerera abantu basanzwe kugira uruhare mu buryo butaziguye bavuye kuri telefone zabo.
intro-list:
• Kubaka ubukungu bwa digitale inclusive
  • Guha imbaraga abantu basanzwe kw'isi
  • Kwongera ikoreshwa rya nyaryo
  • Gushyigikira ubucuruzi bw'umuntu ku muntu
ch1-p2: Intambwe 2: Iyandikishe na Facebook cyangwa Terefone → Andika code: CHIGALEX1 → Bonye igihembo cya 1 Pi
ch1-p3: Ubucukuzi bwa Buri Munsi: Garuka buri ma saa 24 hanyuma ukande buto y'umurabyo kugirango ukomeze ubucukuzi.
ch1-list:
• Kora wallet ya Pi mu mutekano
  • Zuza 2FA
  • Zuza KYC
  • Tegura kwimukira kwa Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Umutekano wa Wallet: NTIBAZE usangize amagambo yawe 24 y'ibanga! Ikipe ya Pi Core NTIZAZIGERA ibikubaza!
ch2: IGICE CYA 2 — UBUREZI BWA WALLET YA PI
ch2-p1: Wallet ya Pi yawe ni banki yawe muri Pi Ecosystem. Ifata amafaranga yawe ya Pi mu mutekano kuri blockchain.
ch2-p2: Uburyo bwo Kurema: Fungura Pi Browser → Wallet → Kora Wallet → KOPIYA amagambo yawe 24 → Bika offline ahantu 2 hizewe.
ch2-p3: Kwakira Pi: Sangiza aderesi yawe rusange (itangira na G...). Kohereza Pi: Gerekaho aderesi y'umwakirizi, andika umubare, emeza.
ch2a-p1: Bifatika: Tangira n'amafaranga make y'igerageza (1 Pi). Emeza ko inyuguti 4 za mbere na 4 za nyuma za aderesi zihura. Ntuzigere ushyira passphrase yawe kurubuga urwo arirwo rwose!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser imeze nka Google Play Store ya Pi. DApps ni porogaramu zatatanye z'ikoreshwa nyaryo — kugura, uburezi, imikino, serivisi zose zikoresheje Pi.
ch4-p1: Vumbura ubucuruzi bwemera Pi kw'isi yose kuri mapofpi.com. Iyandikishe ubucuruzi bwawe bwite utangire kwakira Pi ku bicuruzwa na serivisi.
ch5-p1: Agaciro k'Ubwumvikane ku Isi (GCV) gashishikariza ikoreshwa nyaryo. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Agaciro kariyubatswe n'abapayiniya bakoresha Pi mu bucuruzi nyabwo.
ch6-p1: Iga igitabo cya Doris Yin cyo kurema ikoreshwa no gukura kwa ecosystem. Kora ubushakashatsi, iga, wigishe abandi — ubu nibwo buryo dushimangira Afurika.
final-msg: Afurika ifite amahirwe yo kuba imwe mu turere dukomeye mu ikoreshwa rifatika muri Pi Ecosystem. Hamwe Twubaka. Hamwe Turigisha.
